title: Validated resource is rebound before use

scenario.observed_change: An operation validates that a logical resource belongs to an allowed scope, releases the validation context, and later resolves the same logical identifier again before performing a privileged mutation.
controlled_inputs: indirection or binding chosen by another actor
mutable_state: mapping from logical identifier to effective resource
authority_boundaries: allowed resource scope versus resources outside that scope
operation_model: perform privileged mutation on newly effective resource

required_invariants.requirement: The safety decision must remain bound to the same effective target through the operation that relies on it.

must_investigate: whether validation and use resolve the same stable effective identity
which actor can mutate the binding during the decision-to-use interval
must_identify: re-resolution after a mutable interval can make the operation act on a resource that was never validated
must_not_claim: safe containment solely because the original logical identifier passed validation
